project.name: WLJ 1.0 Release Punch List
project.description: Pre-release verification and completion tasks for Whole Life Journey v1.0. Covers security fixes, integration testing gaps, functional completeness, and documentation needed before launch.

description.objective: Implement proper webhook signature verification for Plaid callbacks to prevent unauthorized webhook calls.
actions: Read Plaid webhook verification documentation for signature format.
Add PLAID_WEBHOOK_SECRET to settings and environment configuration.
Implement verify_plaid_webhook_signature() function in finance/services.
Extract signature from Plaid-Verification header.
Compute expected signature using HMAC-SHA256.
Compare signatures using constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks.
Return 401 for invalid signatures, log attempt.
Update webhook view to call verification before processing.
Add tests for valid signature, invalid signature, missing header scenarios.
description.output: Plaid webhooks are cryptographically verified before processing, with tests confirming security.

description.objective: Encrypt patient portal credentials stored in MedicalProvider model to protect sensitive login information.
actions: Audit MedicalProvider model for credential storage fields.
If portal_username/portal_password fields exist, implement encryption.
Create health/encryption.py with encrypt_credential() and decrypt_credential() functions.
Use Fernet symmetric encryption with key from settings.
Add CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY to environment variables.
Create custom EncryptedCharField or use django-encrypted-model-fields.
Migrate existing plaintext credentials to encrypted format.
Update views to decrypt on read, encrypt on write.
Add tests for encryption/decryption round-trip.
If no credential fields exist, remove this task or document decision not to store them.
description.output: Patient portal credentials are encrypted at rest with secure key management.

description.objective: Verify that Plaid access tokens in BankConnection model are properly encrypted and not stored in plaintext.
actions: Read BankConnection model and identify access_token field.
Verify field uses encryption (EncryptedTextField or similar).

Check that tokens are never logged or exposed in error messages.
Add test that raw database value differs from decrypted value.
Document encryption approach in security documentation.
description.output: Plaid access tokens confirmed encrypted at rest with audit documentation.
